reasoning_trace: The query image shows a tall, slender cardboard box with relatively flat and parallel vertical sidewalls. The gecko gripper requires flat, parallel surfaces for its rigid mushroom-tipped dry-adhesive pads. Cardboard is moderately smooth and dry, making it feasible for gecko adhesion, although its slight porosity and texture prevent optimal adhesion performance. Without authoritative mass measurements, the object size implies a lightweight package. Accounting for the reduced adhesion on porous cardboard versus perfectly smooth surfaces, a moderate pre-load normal force of 1.5 N is estimated to ensure secure contact and adequate frictional/adhesive support for lifting within the 0 to 8 N controller limits.
